values.note: Electric sites at the top of the range; sites 35-36 have no electric. A stay of 7+ nights pays for 6 of every 7. Dump station $5 for registered campers. No refunds; changes $10 each, and cancelling 10+ days out leaves an account credit.

values.note: Full service May 1 - Sep 30. October-April is self-registration, 3 nights at a time, with very limited facilities and access not guaranteed.

values.note: Clark County WebTrac, or by phone to the Forestry and Parks office. Bookings open January 1 for the same calendar year only and close 3 days before arrival; within 3 days every unreserved site is first come, first served. Check-in 3 PM, check-out 1 PM.

note: Clark County campground in wooded loops above Sherwood Lake, with a swimming area, boat launch, fishing pier and a nine-hole disc golf course. No ATVs. Generators are generally not allowed. --Claude
